manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball moves on a fixed height scale with a launch-height guide. The blue Motion arrow shortens going up, is absent at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),2*T);const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const H=u*u/(2*g);const base=380,sc=60;const by=base-h*sc*1;const x=300;const still=Math.abs(v)<0.02;const st=still?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({x:10,y:40,w:620,h:370,title:'Toss',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',100,base,520,base,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',105,base+16,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,by-14,28,{}));const bx=x;o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:bx-40,y:by-14},{value:still?0:v,direction:'up'},{scale:25,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:bx+40,y:by-14},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:8,minLength:12,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(380,150,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:T,apexHeight:H,velocity:v,height:h}};}
